DEU.tuition: 0€ Tuition at almost all Public Universities (Only €250-€350/sem semester ticket)
DEU.psw: 18 Months Job Search Visa (EU Blue Card path in 21-27 months)
DEU.ielts: Safe: 6.5 (min 6.0 in all bands); Top TUs: 7.0; MOI acceptable in selected private/partner universities
DEU.visaDhaka: German Embassy Dhaka uses CSP / waiting list system (apply early as appointment queue can take 8-14 months)
DEU.successTip: Apply through uni-assist or direct university portals by July 15 for Winter intake. DAAD EPOS requires 2 years of work experience.

ETH.tuition: $1,500 - $3,500 / year (Addis Ababa University & public universities; AU bilateral quotas available)
ETH.blockedAccount: Minimal bank solvency proof ($2,000 - $3,000) or official sponsoring agency letter
ETH.psw: Work permit subject to employer sponsorship and institutional research roles
ETH.ielts: IELTS 5.5 - 6.0 or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Bangladesh
ETH.visaDhaka: Processed via Embassy of Ethiopia / electronic business & student visa portal with university admission letter
ETH.successTip: Addis Ababa University is the premier research institution in the Horn of Africa with specialized programs in public health, agriculture, and development studies.

GBR.tuition: £14,000 - £26,000 / year (Wide scholarships from £2,000 discounts up to 100% Chevening/Commonwealth)
GBR.blockedAccount: 28-day Bank Solvency (Tuition balance + 9 months living cost)
GBR.psw: 2 Years Graduate Route Visa (3 Years for PhD)
GBR.ielts: Overall 6.0 to 6.5 (many UK universities accept MOI / Duolingo or offer internal English test)
GBR.cgpa: Undergrad: HSC GPA 4.0+ / Masters: 2.75+ for general, 3.3+ for Russell Group
GBR.visaDhaka: VFS Global Dhaka (Processing 3-4 weeks standard, 5 days priority)
GBR.successTip: UK CAS issuance requires strict credibility audit and genuine student intent. Chevening deadline is early November.

USA.tuition: $20,000 - $55,000 / year (Extensive Assistantships: TA/RA covering 100% tuition + monthly stipend for STEM Masters/PhD)
USA.blockedAccount: I-20 financial proof (1 year tuition + living demonstrated in bank sponsor)
USA.psw: 3 Years STEM OPT (1 Year for non-STEM) with H-1B lottery eligibility
USA.cgpa: Safe: 3.2+; Competitive for TA/RA: 3.5+ with research publications or GRE
USA.visaDhaka: US Embassy Dhaka F-1 Visa interview (Crucial: Strong home ties, funding clarity, academic readiness)
USA.successTip: For graduate studies, contact professors directly with research fit. Fulbright deadline is usually May/June in Dhaka.

ITA.tuition: Low public university fees based on ISEE-Parificato family income (€150 - €2,000/yr)
ITA.blockedAccount: Approx €6,000 - €7,000 in sponsor account (DSU recipients can get living stipend + free canteen)
ITA.psw: 1 Year Post-Study Permesso di Soggiorno (Job search or entrepreneurship)
ITA.ielts: IELTS 6.0 - 6.5 (Some universities accept English MOI letter from Bangladesh)
ITA.visaDhaka: Italian Embassy Dhaka (Requires Universitaly pre-enrolment, CIMEA / DoV, and VFS booking)
ITA.successTip: Regional scholarships like DSU (Tuscany/Lombardy), LazioDisco (Rome), ER.GO (Bologna) cover up to €7,500/year plus free meals!

NLD.tuition: €10,000 - €18,000 / year for Non-EU (Subsidized by NL Scholarship and university excellence funds)
NLD.blockedAccount: Approx €14,000 / year deposited to university account for IND visa sponsor
NLD.psw: 1 Year 'Zoekjaar' (Orientation Year) visa for high-skilled job search
NLD.ielts: Strict IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0) or 7.0 for research masters
NLD.cgpa: Minimum 3.2+; Strong analytical/math foundation verified on Studielink
NLD.visaDhaka: IND institutional sponsor handles MVV; student collects sticker at Dutch Embassy Dhaka within 2-3 weeks
NLD.successTip: High English proficiency across 95% of society. Apply early (by Jan/Feb) for university housing as student housing is competitive.

SWE.tuition: SEK 90,000 - 150,000 / year (SI Global Professionals covers 100% tuition + SEK 12,000/mo stipend + travel grant)
SWE.blockedAccount: SEK 10,500/month for Migration Agency (Migrationsverket) residence permit
SWE.psw: 1 Year Job Search Visa after graduation
SWE.ielts: Strict English 6 requirement: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 5.5)
SWE.cgpa: Competitive: 3.3+ with 3,000 hours of demonstrated leadership/work experience for SI
SWE.visaDhaka: Swedish Migration Agency online permit + biometric verification at Swedish Embassy Dhaka
SWE.successTip: Centralized application via UniversityAdmissions.se opens in October and closes mid-January. SI application opens in February.

FIN.tuition: €10,000 - €13,000 / year (Finland Scholarship awards 100% waiver + €5,000 relocation grant; Universities offer 50-100% waivers)
FIN.blockedAccount: €6,720 / year (€560/month) required by Migri for student residence permit
FIN.psw: 2 Years Job Search Residence Permit (one of the most generous in Europe!)
FIN.cgpa: Minimum 3.0/4.0; 3.4+ strongly positioned for Finland Scholarship award
FIN.visaDhaka: Migri online application + VFS Dhaka biometric appointment
FIN.successTip: Joint Application (Studyinfo.fi) takes place in January for August intake. Students can work up to 30 hours per week!

JPN.tuition: National universities: ¥535,800/yr (approx $3,500 USD) + 50% or 100% tuition exemption available for foreign students
JPN.blockedAccount: Sponsor bank balance of 15-20 Lakh BDT for COE (Certificate of Eligibility)
JPN.psw: Designated Activities Visa for 1-2 years job hunting in Japan
JPN.ielts: IELTS 6.0 - 6.5 for English-taught degree programs (SGU / Global 30)
JPN.cgpa: Minimum 3.0+; MEXT Embassy Track requires high academic standing and written exam
JPN.visaDhaka: Japanese Embassy Dhaka issues visa within 5-7 working days after receiving university COE
JPN.successTip: MEXT Scholarship covers 100% tuition + ¥144,000/month stipend + return airfare! University recommendation track deadline is Dec-Jan.

KOR.tuition: $2,000 - $5,000 / semester (Very generous university scholarships 30%-100% based on GPA/TOPIK)
KOR.blockedAccount: Approx $10,000 - $20,000 bank statement depending on whether university is inside Seoul
KOR.psw: D-10 Job Seeker Visa for up to 2 years with point-based transition to E-7 work visa
KOR.ielts: IELTS 5.5 - 6.5 for English programs, or TOPIK Level 3+ for Korean programs
KOR.cgpa: Minimum 2.8+; GKS scholarship requires top 20% ranking (CGPA 3.3+)
KOR.visaDhaka: Korean Embassy Dhaka (requires Apostille / Embassy legalisation of academic certificates)
KOR.successTip: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) covers 100% tuition, monthly 1,000,000 KRW stipend, 1 year Korean language training, and airfare.

CAN.blockedAccount: GIC (Guaranteed Investment Certificate) approx CAD $20,635 + first year tuition receipt
CAN.psw: Up to 3 Years Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP)
CAN.ielts: Strict IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0) for university admission & study permit
CAN.cgpa: Minimum 3.0+; Graduate research positions offer RA/TA stipends
CAN.visaDhaka: IRCC online application + VFS Dhaka biometric appointment
CAN.successTip: Research-based Master's in STEM often come with funded supervisor packages. Vanier and Trudeaux scholarships available for PhD.

AUS.tuition: AUD $28,000 - $46,000 / year (Vice-Chancellor scholarships offer 20%-50% tuition reduction)
AUS.livingCost: AUD $2,000 / month (annual requirement: AUD $29,710 for visa)
AUS.blockedAccount: Demonstrated 1-year living cost + remaining tuition + travel in credible bank history
AUS.psw: 2 to 4 Years Temporary Graduate (subclass 485) visa based on qualification & regional campus
AUS.ielts: IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0 in each band) or PTE 58-64
AUS.cgpa: Bachelor: 2.8+ / Master: 3.0+ (Group of Eight universities expect 3.2+)
AUS.visaDhaka: Subclass 500 online visa via ImmiAccount + biometrics at VFS Dhaka (Genuine Student GS audit)
AUS.successTip: Australia Awards (AAS) is 100% funded for Bangladeshi mid-career professionals. RTP scholarships cover full PhD fees + $32k stipend.

HUN.blockedAccount: Stipendium Hungaricum awardees are exempt from bank solvency!
HUN.psw: 9 Months Study-to-Work visa for job seeking in Hungary
HUN.cgpa: Minimum 2.8/4.0; Competitive for BD Education Ministry quota: 3.2+
HUN.visaDhaka: Hungarian Embassy New Delhi / Consular services in Dhaka (Excellence Global assists with paperwork)
HUN.successTip: Stipendium Hungaricum is one of the most accessible full-funding schemes for BD students: 100% tuition + monthly stipend + dorm/housing subsidy + health insurance! Application deadline: mid-January via DreamApply & BD MoE.

TUR.tuition: 100% Free under Türkiye Bursları (Public university fees are very low: $300-$1,500/yr)
TUR.blockedAccount: Türkiye Bursları winners are 100% exempt from financial deposits
TUR.psw: Short-term residence permit for job seeking in Turkey
TUR.ielts: English programs require IELTS 6.5; Turkish programs provide 1 year free language prep
TUR.visaDhaka: Turkish Embassy Dhaka (Direct visa issuance upon presenting TB scholarship award letter)
TUR.successTip: Türkiye Bursları offers 100% free tuition, monthly stipend, university dorm accommodation, health insurance, and round-trip flight tickets! Apply annually from Jan 10 to Feb 20.

SAU.tuition: 100% Free Tuition for accepted international graduate students at top universities (KAUST, KFUPM, KSU)
SAU.livingCost: Zero (Fully covered by scholarship stipends + free on-campus housing)
SAU.blockedAccount: None required — universities provide full sponsorship
SAU.psw: High demand for AI, Petroleum, Renewable Energy, and Biotech specialists in Vision 2030 initiatives
SAU.ielts: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79 for KAUST / KFUPM
SAU.visaDhaka: Saudi Embassy Dhaka visa section through university electronic visa (Wakala)
SAU.successTip: KAUST Fellowship is one of the world's most generous awards: 100% tuition waiver + $20,000 to $30,000 annual living stipend + free private apartment + relocation flights + medical coverage!

KAZ.tuition: 100% Free under Kazakhstan Government Scholarship & Nazarbayev University Grant
KAZ.blockedAccount: Exempt for government quota; $2,500 - $3,500 bank solvency for self-funded
KAZ.psw: 1 Year work authorization after graduation with university employer sponsorship
KAZ.ielts: IELTS 5.5 - 6.5 (NU requires 6.5+; KazNU accepts English MOI or internal assessment)
KAZ.cgpa: Undergraduate: HSC GPA 3.5+; Masters: CGPA 2.8+; Nazarbayev University: 3.3+
KAZ.visaDhaka: Embassy of Kazakhstan in Dhaka (Gulshan) issues C9 student visa within 7-10 working days upon university invitation letter
KAZ.successTip: Bilateral quota circularized via Bangladesh Ministry of Education (MoE). Nazarbayev University is world-class, English-medium with state-of-the-art campus in Astana.

KGZ.tuition: 100% Free under Kyrgyz Republic Bilateral Quota ($1,800 - $3,500/yr for general programs)
KGZ.blockedAccount: Minimal solvency proof ($2,000 - $3,000) or government scholarship award certificate
KGZ.psw: Registration renewal possible via local employment contract
KGZ.ielts: IELTS not strictly mandatory; MOI certificate or preparatory Russian/English year accepted
KGZ.visaDhaka: Electronic visa (e-Visa) via Kyrgyz MFA portal with university telex invitation number, endorsed upon arrival or via New Delhi consulate
KGZ.successTip: Popular for medical and technical studies. Apply through Bangladesh Ministry of Education bilateral circulars or direct university intake.

AZE.tuition: 100% Free under Heydar Aliyev NAM / OIC Scholarship Grant & ADA University Fellowship
AZE.blockedAccount: Exempt for scholarship holders; $3,000 - $4,000 bank certificate for private/general applicants
AZE.psw: Temporary residence permit (TRP) extendable with employer contract in Baku
AZE.ielts: IELTS 6.0 (ADA University requires 6.5) or institutional English exam
AZE.cgpa: Minimum 3.0/4.0; Competitive for Heydar Aliyev Grant: 3.4+
AZE.visaDhaka: Azerbaijan ASAN e-Visa online or student visa via Azerbaijan Embassy New Delhi with MoFA Baku telex
AZE.successTip: Heydar Aliyev Grant covers 100% tuition, monthly stipend of 800 AZN (~$470), dormitory accommodation, health insurance, and annual return flights!

EGY.tuition: 100% Free under Egyptian Ministry of Higher Education Quota & Al-Azhar University Bilateral Scholarship
EGY.livingCost: $150 - $300 / month (approx 18,000 - 36,000 BDT — very low cost of living)
EGY.blockedAccount: None required for government/Al-Azhar scholarship recipients
EGY.psw: Post-graduate employment opportunities in multilateral NGOs, translation, and trade
EGY.ielts: IELTS 5.5 - 6.0 for English engineering programs; Arabic proficiency or 1-year language institute for Islamic/theology faculties
EGY.visaDhaka: Egyptian Embassy Dhaka (Gulshan) issues study visa upon receipt of MoFA Cairo security clearance and nomination letter
EGY.successTip: Circulars released annually through Bangladesh Ministry of Education (SHED) and Islamic Foundation. Covers tuition, free university dorm, and monthly living allowance.

MAR.tuition: 100% Free under Kingdom of Morocco AMCI (Agence Marocaine de Coopération Internationale) Quota
MAR.psw: Residence permit renewable with local employment contract
MAR.ielts: English programs accept IELTS 6.0 or MOI; French/Arabic language prep provided for francophone degrees
MAR.visaDhaka: Embassy of the Kingdom of Morocco in Dhaka issues student visa upon AMCI nomination certificate
MAR.successTip: Official bilateral government quota for Bangladesh. Includes full tuition waiver, subsidized student housing at Cité Universitaire, and monthly stipend.

SRB.tuition: 100% Free under 'The World in Serbia' (Svet u Srbiji) Government Scholarship
SRB.psw: 1 Year job search permit post-graduation with pathway to European tech employment
SRB.ielts: IELTS 6.0 or English MOI; includes 1-year Serbian language preparatory course
SRB.visaDhaka: Serbian Embassy New Delhi / Consular services; visa type D for long-term study
SRB.successTip: Full scholarship covers tuition, accommodation in student halls, free meals (3 meals/day in student canteens), monthly stipend of 15,000 RSD, health insurance, and local transport.

CUB.tuition: 100% Free under ELAM (Escuela Latinoamericana de Medicina) Bilateral Medical Scholarship
CUB.livingCost: Fully covered by Cuban government (Dormitory + 3 meals daily included)
CUB.psw: Medical graduates return to Bangladesh for BMDC licensing examination
CUB.ielts: No IELTS required; 1-year intensive medical Spanish preparatory training included
CUB.cgpa: HSC Science (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) GPA 4.5+ with minimum A grade in Biology
CUB.visaDhaka: Embassy of Cuba in Dhaka issues official student visa upon Ministry of Education nomination
CUB.successTip: Prestigious 6-year Doctor of Medicine (MD) program. Covers 100% tuition, textbooks, dormitory accommodation, hospital training, food, and emergency medical care.

RUS.tuition: 100% Free under Russian Government Quota (Rossotrudnichestvo) and Open Doors Olympiad
RUS.psw: 3 Years RVP-V (Temporary Residence Permit for Education) with simplified path to work visa
RUS.ielts: No IELTS required for Russian-taught programs (includes 1-year Podfak preparatory faculty); IELTS 6.0 for English programs
RUS.cgpa: HSC GPA 3.5+; Undergrad CGPA 3.0+; Open Doors Olympiad winners get direct Masters/PhD admission
RUS.visaDhaka: Russian House (Russian Cultural Centre) in Dhaka conducts interviews; Russian Embassy Dhaka issues student visa
RUS.successTip: Over 100+ fully funded spots allocated annually to Bangladesh through Russian House in Dhanmondi, Dhaka. Free tuition, subsidized dorm (~$20/mo), and monthly stipend.

MYS.tuition: RM 12,000 - 25,000 / year (Very affordable top-ranked universities: UM, USM, UKM, UTM, UPM)
MYS.blockedAccount: Sponsor bank solvency statement of 5-8 Lakh BDT
MYS.psw: Social Visit Pass extensions and Employment Pass (Cat I, II, III) for graduates
MYS.ielts: IELTS 5.5 - 6.5 or MUET Band 4; English MOI accepted for research degrees
MYS.cgpa: Undergraduate: HSC GPA 3.5+; Masters: CGPA 3.0+ (3.5+ for MTCP and MIS scholarships)
MYS.visaDhaka: EMGS (Education Malaysia Global Services) online VAL approval + single entry visa (eVISA) via High Commission of Malaysia Dhaka
MYS.successTip: MTCP & MIS scholarships cover 100% tuition + monthly living allowance + book/travel grant. High QS rankings (UM in top 60 world rank) and close cultural proximity to Bangladesh.

THA.tuition: 100% Free under TIPP (TICA), Chulabhorn Graduate Institute, SIIT, and AIT Royal Thai Fellowships
THA.blockedAccount: Exempt for full scholarship winners; approx 4-6 Lakh BDT for self-funded
THA.psw: Non-Immigrant B visa with local tech/engineering employment or multinational regional HQs
THA.ielts: IELTS 6.0 - 6.5 or institutional English test (AIT EET / SIIT test)
THA.visaDhaka: Royal Thai Embassy Dhaka issues Non-Immigrant ED visa within 5-7 working days via VFS Thailand Dhaka
THA.successTip: Chulabhorn Graduate Institute (CGI) and TICA scholarships cover 100% tuition, monthly allowance (18,000 THB), round-trip airfare, accommodation, and book allowance for STEM/Biotech.

IDN.tuition: 100% Free under KNB Scholarship (Kemitraan Negara Berkembang) and UI Great Fellowship
IDN.blockedAccount: Exempt for KNB and university full scholarship awardees
IDN.psw: Limited post-study stay; opportunities in ASEAN regional tech hubs and research institutions
IDN.ielts: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 500; includes 1-year Bahasa Indonesia preparatory course
IDN.visaDhaka: Indonesian Embassy Dhaka (Gulshan) issues socio-cultural / student telex visa upon receipt of MoEC permit
IDN.successTip: KNB Scholarship covers 100% tuition, settlement allowance, monthly living allowance (approx IDR 4,000,000), health insurance, and round-trip international flight tickets.

PAK.tuition: 100% Free under PTAP (Pakistan Technical Assistance Programme) & Allama Iqbal Bilateral Scholarships
PAK.ielts: No IELTS required — English MOI from Bangladesh recognized
PAK.cgpa: HSC Pre-Medical GPA 4.8+ for PTAP MBBS/BDS; Masters CGPA 3.0+ for Engineering/IT
PAK.visaDhaka: High Commission of Pakistan Dhaka issues student visa upon nomination from Economic Affairs Division (EAD)
PAK.successTip: PTAP allocates dedicated MBBS, BDS, and Engineering seats to Bangladeshi students annually. Applications processed through Ministry of Education, Dhaka.

ROU.tuition: 100% Free under MFA Romania Government Scholarship (Low self-funded fees: €2,000 - €4,500/yr)
ROU.blockedAccount: MFA scholarship winners exempt; €2,000 - €3,000 bank solvency for self-funded
ROU.psw: 9 Months job search residence permit in the European Union
ROU.ielts: No IELTS needed for MFA scholarship (includes 1-year Romanian language prep); IELTS 6.0 for English programs
ROU.visaDhaka: Embassy of Romania in New Delhi or consular missions with MoE acceptance letter
ROU.successTip: MFA Romania scholarship covers 100% tuition, free accommodation in university dormitories, and monthly living allowance. One of Europe's most accessible scholarships for BD students.

SVK.tuition: 0€ Tuition for Slovak-taught programs; €2,000 - €5,000 for English programs (NSP covers 100% stipend)
SVK.blockedAccount: Approx €3,600 / year in student bank account for residence permit
SVK.psw: 9 Months job seeker residence permit in Schengen area
SVK.ielts: IELTS 6.0 or English MOI from previous university
SVK.visaDhaka: Embassy of the Slovak Republic in New Delhi / VFS Schengen
SVK.successTip: National Scholarship Programme (NSP) provides €400 - €1,050 monthly stipend for international Master's and PhD students.

POL.tuition: €2,000 - €4,000 / year (Stefan Banach & NAWA scholarships cover 100% tuition + PLN 1,700/mo stipend)
POL.blockedAccount: Approx PLN 10,000 - 12,000 bank solvency for Polish National Visa
POL.psw: 9 Months Post-study Job Search Residence Permit with EU Blue Card path
POL.visaDhaka: Embassy of Poland in New Delhi (e-Konsulat appointment)
POL.successTip: NAWA Stefan Banach Scholarship offers full tuition waiver + monthly allowance for STEM, IT, and Agriculture Master's degrees.

CZE.tuition: 0€ Tuition for Czech-taught degree programs! English programs: €3,000 - €7,000/yr
CZE.blockedAccount: Approx CZK 135,000 (~$5,800) in bank account for Czech long-term study visa
CZE.psw: 9 Months Job Search Residence Permit across Schengen zone
CZE.visaDhaka: Czech Embassy New Delhi (Requires certified nostrification of prior certificates)
CZE.successTip: Czech Republic Government Scholarship covers 100% tuition + preparatory language year + monthly living stipend of CZK 14,000 - 15,000.

CHN.tuition: 100% Free under Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type A & B), Belt and Road, and Provincial Grants
CHN.livingCost: 2,000 - 3,500 RMB / month (fully covered by CSC stipend of 2,500 - 3,500 RMB/mo)
CHN.blockedAccount: Exempt for CSC and university full scholarship winners
CHN.psw: Work Permit (Z visa) for graduates with Bachelor/Master degrees from Chinese universities
CHN.ielts: IELTS 6.0 or English MOI for English programs; HSK 4+ for Chinese programs
CHN.cgpa: Minimum 3.0/4.0; Top CSC C9 universities look for 3.3+
CHN.visaDhaka: Chinese Visa Application Service Centre (CVASC) in Dhaka issues X1 study visa within 4-5 days
CHN.successTip: CSC Type A (Bilateral via Bangladesh Ministry of Education) and Type B (University direct) cover full tuition, free campus accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance, and 3,000-3,500 RMB monthly stipend.

FRA.tuition: Subsidized public university fees: €2,770 (Bachelors), €3,770 (Masters) / year; Eiffel covers 100%
FRA.livingCost: €700 - €1,000 / month (CAF housing subsidy refunds 30%-40% of room rent!)
FRA.blockedAccount: €615 / month (€7,380/year) required for French student long-stay visa
FRA.psw: 1 to 2 Years 'Receinte d'Autorisation Provisoire de Séjour' (APS) / Job Search Visa
FRA.ielts: IELTS 6.0 - 6.5 for English-taught degrees; B2 French for French-taught
FRA.cgpa: Minimum 3.0/4.0; Eiffel Excellence requires 3.5+ and faculty recommendation
FRA.visaDhaka: Etudes en France (Campus France Bangladesh) + VFS France Dhaka
FRA.successTip: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship is France's premier award: €1,181/mo living stipend for Masters, €1,700/mo for PhD, return air travel, and housing priority.

ESP.tuition: Public universities: €1,000 - €3,500 / year (Very affordable in Andalusia, Valencia, and Madrid)
ESP.blockedAccount: IPREM proof (approx €600/month or €7,200/year in student/sponsor account)
ESP.psw: 1 Year Residence Permit for job search or business launch
ESP.ielts: IELTS 6.0 - 6.5 or MOI letter; B2 DELE/SIELE for Spanish degrees
ESP.visaDhaka: BLS International Dhaka for Spanish Embassy student visa
ESP.successTip: Carolina Foundation & MAEC-AECID provide full scholarships. Very high quality of life and low living costs compared to northern Europe.

PRT.tuition: €1,500 - €4,000 / year (FCT PhD Fellowships provide 100% waiver + €1,200/mo tax-free stipend)
PRT.blockedAccount: Proof of minimum Portuguese national salary (€820/month or €9,840/year)
PRT.psw: 1 Year Job Seeker Visa with fastest pathway to EU citizenship (5 years legal residence)
PRT.ielts: IELTS 6.0 or English MOI accepted by University of Porto, Lisbon, Coimbra
PRT.visaDhaka: VFS Global New Delhi / Embassy of Portugal New Delhi
PRT.successTip: Portugal offers one of the most welcoming immigration frameworks in Europe. FCT Doctoral scholarships cover full fees and generous living allowance.

AUT.tuition: €726.72 / semester for Non-EU students at top public universities (Mach Scholarships available)
AUT.blockedAccount: €6,800 (<24 yrs) or €12,300 (≥24 yrs) per year in bank account
AUT.psw: 12 Months Red-White-Red Card for job seeking
AUT.visaDhaka: Austrian Embassy New Delhi / VFS New Delhi
AUT.successTip: Ernst Mach Grant (OeAD) provides €1,050/month stipend + health insurance for international students and researchers.

BEL.tuition: €1,100 - €4,500 / year (Master Mind Scholarship provides €10,000 grant + tuition waiver)
BEL.blockedAccount: Approx €803/month (€9,636/year) or university blocked account transfer
BEL.psw: 1 Year Orientation Year (zoekjaar) permit for post-study job hunting
BEL.ielts: Strict IELTS 6.5 - 7.0 (KU Leuven, Ghent University, VUB)
BEL.cgpa: Minimum 3.2/4.0; Master Mind requires top 10% class rank (3.5+)
BEL.visaDhaka: Belgian Embassy New Delhi / VFS Dhaka handles biometric submission
BEL.successTip: Master Mind Flemish Government scholarship covers high-achieving Master's candidates at KU Leuven, UGent, and Antwerp.

CHE.tuition: CHF 500 - 800 / semester at ETH Zurich and EPFL (Very low tuition, ESKAS covers everything)
CHE.livingCost: CHF 1,600 - 2,200 / month (approx 2,00,000 - 2,80,000 BDT — high living cost)
CHE.blockedAccount: CHF 21,000 in recognized Swiss bank or scholarship award letter
CHE.psw: 6 Months Job Search Residence Permit for Swiss university graduates
CHE.ielts: IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL 100 for ETH Zurich / EPFL
CHE.cgpa: Competitive: 3.6+ / First class honors with research publications
CHE.visaDhaka: Embassy of Switzerland in Dhaka issues national visa D upon cantonal authority approval
CHE.successTip: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship (ESKAS) covers 100% tuition, monthly CHF 1,920 living stipend, housing allowance, flight tickets, and health insurance!

IRL.tuition: €12,000 - €24,000 / year (GOI-IES covers 100% tuition waiver + €10,000 living stipend)
IRL.blockedAccount: €10,000 immediate living cost evidence in student/sponsor account
IRL.psw: 2 Years Third Level Graduate Scheme (Stamp 1G) for Master's/PhD graduates
IRL.ielts: IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0 in each band) or Duolingo 120
IRL.visaDhaka: Irish Immigration Service online AVATS + VFS Global Dhaka
IRL.successTip: Ireland is the European headquarters for Google, Meta, Apple, and Microsoft. GOI-IES scholarship awards full tuition and €10,000 stipend.

NZL.tuition: NZD $26,000 - $38,000 / year (International PhD students pay low domestic fees: ~NZD $7,000/yr!)
NZL.psw: Up to 3 Years Post-Study Work Visa
NZL.visaDhaka: Processed via designated Embassy/VFS mission or electronic visa with university sponsorship letter.
NZL.successTip: Apply early with verified academic transcripts and strong statement of purpose. Contact Excellence Global team for document audit and roadmap.

NOR.tuition: NOK 130,000 - 200,000 / year (PhD positions are salaried jobs: ~NOK 530,000/yr salary!)
NOR.blockedAccount: NOK 151,690 deposited into Norwegian university bank account for UDI residence permit
NOR.psw: 1 Year Job Seeker Residence Permit after Master's graduation
NOR.visaDhaka: Processed via designated Embassy/VFS mission or electronic visa with university sponsorship letter.
NOR.successTip: Apply early with verified academic transcripts and strong statement of purpose. Contact Excellence Global team for document audit and roadmap.

DNK.tuition: €8,000 - €16,000 / year (Danish Government Scholarship covers 100% tuition + monthly living grant)
DNK.blockedAccount: Demonstrated living funds (approx DKK 6,820/month) for SIRI residence permit
DNK.psw: 3 Years Post-Study Job Search Residence Permit (Establishment Card)
DNK.visaDhaka: Processed via designated Embassy/VFS mission or electronic visa with university sponsorship letter.
DNK.successTip: Apply early with verified academic transcripts and strong statement of purpose. Contact Excellence Global team for document audit and roadmap.

MEX.tuition: 100% Free under AMEXCID Excellence Scholarship for International Students
MEX.psw: Temporary resident permit extendable for employment
MEX.ielts: English programs accept IELTS 6.0; Spanish programs require DELE B2
